summary.zh: 动名词是由动词加 -ing 构成、在句中具有名词功能的非谓语动词形式。它可以作主语、宾语、表语、介词宾语，也常出现在学术写作和 PTE Academic 的听力、阅读、写作与口语任务中。中国学习者常把动名词与现在分词混淆，或在固定搭配后误用不定式。掌握动名词的核心是理解：它保留动词意义，但在语法位置上相当于名词。

structure.formula: Verb + -ing = Gerund；Gerund / Gerund phrase + 谓语；动词/介词 + Gerund
structure.explanation: 动名词的形式与现在分词相同，都是 Verb + -ing，但功能不同。动名词在句中充当名词成分，例如作主语、宾语或介词宾语；现在分词通常表示进行、主动或修饰名词。动名词短语可以带宾语、状语或逻辑主语，例如：conducting research、students' improving their academic writing。正式英语中，动名词常用于概括行为、讨论抽象过程和表达学术观点。

examples.en: Reading academic articles improves students' vocabulary range.
examples.zh: 阅读学术文章能提高学生的词汇范围。

examples.en: The lecturer emphasized avoiding plagiarism in research papers.
examples.zh: 讲师强调在研究论文中避免抄袭。

examples.en: Many candidates struggle with managing time in the PTE Reading section.
examples.zh: 许多考生在 PTE 阅读部分很难管理时间。

usage_scenarios.title: 作主语
usage_scenarios.description: 动名词可以放在句首作主语，用来表达一种活动、过程或普遍现象。在学术写作中，这种结构比使用具体人称更正式，适合描述研究行为、学习策略或社会现象。

examples.en: Developing critical thinking is essential for university students.
examples.zh: 培养批判性思维对大学生来说至关重要。

examples.en: Reducing carbon emissions requires international cooperation.
examples.zh: 减少碳排放需要国际合作。

usage_scenarios.title: 作动词宾语
usage_scenarios.description: 某些动词后面必须或通常接动名词，而不能接 to-infinitive。这类动词包括 avoid, consider, enjoy, finish, mind, practise, suggest, deny, admit, risk 等。PTE 写作中经常需要使用这些动词来表达建议、态度或过程。

examples.en: Experts suggest investing more in renewable energy.
examples.zh: 专家建议在可再生能源方面投入更多资金。

examples.en: The company denied using misleading advertising.
examples.zh: 该公司否认使用误导性广告。

usage_scenarios.title: 作介词宾语
usage_scenarios.description: 介词后必须使用名词性成分，因此当介词后出现动词意义时，应使用动名词。常见结构包括 be interested in doing, be responsible for doing, focus on doing, instead of doing, by doing, after doing 等。

examples.en: Students can improve pronunciation by listening to native speakers.
examples.zh: 学生可以通过听母语者讲话来提高发音。

examples.en: Governments should focus on providing affordable housing.
examples.zh: 政府应该专注于提供可负担住房。

usage_scenarios.title: 作表语
usage_scenarios.description: 动名词可以位于系动词后作表语，用来说明主语的内容或本质。它常用于解释某个问题、目标、任务或策略的核心行为。

examples.en: One major challenge is maintaining accuracy under time pressure.
examples.zh: 一个主要挑战是在时间压力下保持准确性。

examples.en: The main purpose of the project is improving access to education.
examples.zh: 该项目的主要目的是改善教育机会。

usage_scenarios.title: 用于固定表达
usage_scenarios.description: 许多固定表达后接动名词，例如 look forward to doing, be used to doing, have difficulty doing, spend time doing, there is no point in doing。这些表达在 IELTS 写作和 PTE 口语复述中都很常见。

examples.en: Many international students have difficulty adapting to a new academic culture.
examples.zh: 许多国际学生很难适应新的学术文化。

examples.en: There is no point in memorising answers without understanding grammar.
examples.zh: 不理解语法而死记答案是没有意义的。

usage_scenarios.title: 带逻辑主语的动名词
usage_scenarios.description: 当需要明确说明动名词动作的执行者时，可以在动名词前加名词所有格、形容词性物主代词或宾格形式。正式写作中更推荐所有格形式，如 students' participating；口语中常见 students participating。

examples.en: The professor appreciated the students' submitting their assignments early.
examples.zh: 教授很欣赏学生们提前提交作业。

examples.en: I do not mind them discussing the issue after class.
examples.zh: 我不介意他们课后讨论这个问题。

common_mistakes.wrong: Experts suggest to reduce plastic waste.
common_mistakes.explanation: suggest 后通常接动名词，不接 to do。中文“建议去做”容易让学习者误用 to-infinitive，但英语中应说 suggest doing something。

common_mistakes.wrong: I am interested to study environmental science.
common_mistakes.correct: I am interested in studying environmental science.
common_mistakes.explanation: be interested in 中的 in 是介词，介词后如果接动词，必须使用动名词 studying。

common_mistakes.wrong: Read books is good for language learning.
common_mistakes.correct: Reading books is good for language learning.
common_mistakes.explanation: 句首作主语时，动词不能直接用原形。表达“读书这件事”应使用动名词 Reading books。

common_mistakes.wrong: The government should prevent people to smoke in public areas.
common_mistakes.correct: The government should prevent people from smoking in public areas.
common_mistakes.explanation: prevent somebody from doing something 是固定结构，from 是介词，后接动名词。

common_mistakes.wrong: She avoided to answer the difficult question.
common_mistakes.correct: She avoided answering the difficult question.
common_mistakes.explanation: avoid 后接动名词。该动词表示“避免做某事”，不能接 to answer。

common_mistakes.wrong: I look forward to meet you.
common_mistakes.correct: I look forward to meeting you.
common_mistakes.explanation: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，不是不定式标志，因此后面必须接动名词 meeting。

common_mistakes.wrong: The main problem is to finding reliable data.
common_mistakes.correct: The main problem is finding reliable data.
common_mistakes.explanation: is 后作表语时可以用动名词 finding，不能把 to 和 -ing 混合成 to finding，除非 to 是介词结构的一部分。
admit 后接动名词，表示承认做过某事。直接接动词原形不符合英语句法。

pte_usage.description: 动名词在 PTE Academic 中出现频率较高，尤其是在 Reading & Writing: Fill in the Blanks、Listening: Fill in the Blanks、Summarize Written Text、Write Essay、Repeat Sentence 和 Retell Lecture 中。考生需要识别哪些动词、介词和固定搭配后接动名词，并在写作中用动名词短语提升句子紧凑度与学术性。动名词常用于概括观点，例如 improving public transport、reducing inequality、addressing climate change，这类表达适合用于议论文主题句和总结句。
sections: Reading & Writing: Fill in the Blanks

academic_patterns.pattern: Doing something is essential for achieving long-term success.
academic_patterns.translation: 做某事对于取得长期成功至关重要。

academic_patterns.pattern: One effective way of addressing this issue is doing something.
academic_patterns.translation: 解决这一问题的一种有效方式是做某事。

academic_patterns.pattern: There is increasing evidence supporting the idea of doing something.
academic_patterns.translation: 越来越多的证据支持做某事这一观点。

academic_patterns.pattern: Governments should place greater emphasis on doing something.
academic_patterns.translation: 政府应该更加重视做某事。

academic_patterns.pattern: This approach contributes to improving overall efficiency.
academic_patterns.translation: 这种方法有助于提高整体效率。

academic_patterns.pattern: Instead of relying on short-term solutions, policymakers should consider doing something.
academic_patterns.translation: 政策制定者不应依赖短期方案，而应考虑做某事。

academic_patterns.pattern: The benefits of doing something outweigh the potential drawbacks.
academic_patterns.translation: 做某事的好处超过其潜在缺点。

academic_patterns.pattern: By doing something, individuals can develop a deeper understanding of the issue.
academic_patterns.translation: 通过做某事，个人可以对该问题形成更深入的理解。

ai_tips: 判断是否用动名词时，先看前面是否是介词；如果是介词，后面的动词通常要变成 -ing 形式。
在 PTE Fill in the Blanks 中，遇到 suggest、avoid、consider、deny、admit、finish 等动词时，要优先检查选项中是否有 -ing 形式。
写作中可以用动名词短语作主语来避免频繁使用 people、we、they，使句子更正式，例如用 Reducing waste is necessary 代替 We need to reduce waste。
不要把所有 -ing 都理解为进行时；如果 -ing 形式在句中作主语、宾语或介词宾语，它就是动名词。
遇到 look forward to、be used to、object to、contribute to 等结构时，要记住其中的 to 是介词，不是不定式符号。

practice_questions.question: 选择正确形式：Experts recommend ______ more resources in early childhood education. A. invest B. to invest C. investing
practice_questions.answer: C. investing。recommend 后可接动名词，表示“建议做某事”。

practice_questions.question: 改错：Many students have difficulty to understand academic lectures.
practice_questions.answer: Many students have difficulty understanding academic lectures. have difficulty doing something 是固定表达。

practice_questions.question: 翻译：减少空气污染需要政府和个人共同努力。
practice_questions.answer: Reducing air pollution requires joint efforts from governments and individuals.

practice_questions.question: 选择正确形式：The report focuses on ______ the causes of unemployment. A. analysing B. analyse C. to analyse
practice_questions.answer: A. analysing。focus on 中的 on 是介词，后接动名词。

practice_questions.question: 改写句子，使其更学术：We should recycle more to protect the environment.
practice_questions.answer: Recycling more is an effective way to protect the environment.

practice_questions.question: 选择正确形式：She denied ______ confidential information to the media. A. reveal B. revealing C. to reveal
翻译：通过练习复述讲座，考生可以提高口语流利度。
practice_questions.answer: By practising retelling lectures, candidates can improve their oral fluency.

practice_questions.question: 改错：I look forward to hear your response.
practice_questions.answer: I look forward to hearing your response. look forward to 后接动名词，因为 to 是介词。

practice_questions.question: 填空：There is no point in ______ answers without understanding the logic. A. memorise B. memorising C. to memorise
practice_questions.answer: B. memorising。There is no point in doing something 表示“做某事没有意义”。

practice_questions.question: 用动名词作主语造句，表达“学习语法能提高写作准确性”。
practice_questions.answer: Learning grammar can improve writing accuracy.
